name: canyon-skills
description: Working modes and working docs: skills that change how an AI assistant thinks through a problem, and carry work across sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Working modes that set how the assistant thinks for a session, and working docs that carry work across sessions.
interface.longDescription: Seven working modes (explorer, interrogator, evaluator, planner, implementer, troubleshooter, validator), each built on two named frames the model already knows, plus three working-docs skills (working-doc, handoff-doc, kickoff-prompt) for work that outlives one conversation. Modes are invoked by name and stay on until you switch.
defaultPrompt: Use explorer-mode to open this problem up before we decide anything
Write a handoff-doc for this session
